title: Aidoc, which provides AI medical imaging software to flag incidental findings on CT scans and X-rays, raised a $150M Series E, taking its total funding to $520M (Brock E.W. Turner/Axios)
summary: Brock E.W. Turner / Axios: Aidoc, which provides AI medical imaging software to flag incidental findings on CT scans and X-rays, raised a $150M Series E, taking its total funding to $520M — Aidoc, a clinical AI medical imaging provider, raised $150 million in Series E funding, CEO Elad Walach tells Axios Pro exclusively.
